name: TC-176: a coupon and a gift card can both be applied to the same order
description: The frontend doesn't gate gift-card redemption on whether a coupon is already applied (or vice versa) — both discounts show simultaneously. This documents currently-supported behavior; it does not touch the separate canCombineWithCoupons config flag, which isn't enforced by either side today (see TEST_COVERAGE.md's Known Technical Debt).

steps.name: Seed a coupon and a gift card
Apply both the coupon and the gift card
Wait for selector locator('div').filter({ has: getByText('Have a coupon code?', { exact: true }) }).last().getByPlaceholder('Enter code')
Fill "AUTO0627F5D0" locator('div').filter({ has: getByText('Have a coupon code?', { exact: true }) }).last().getByPlaceholder('Enter code')
Click locator('div').filter({ has: getByText('Have a coupon code?', { exact: true }) }).last().getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Fill "AUTOGCMUQIOAQOZYAMEU" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByPlaceholder('Enter your gift card number')
Click getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Gift Card', exact: true }).locator('xpath=ancestor::div[2]').getByText(/Gift card applied: -\$\d/)
